rules.name: xoga713-deploy-check-core-engine
rules.sql: SELECT orderexecuted, id, author, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id IN ('create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v2', 'create-helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view-v2', 'create-helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view-v2-bu', 'add-tenant_id-to-curr_mult_table-v1', 'create-rmo-join-indexes-v1', 'create-deal_ticket_security_info_table_view-v1', 'create-helper-cash-balance-report-view-fast-v2-active-lot-cache', 'create-helper_eod_monthend_report_view-v2-bu', 'create-helper_risk_middle_office_reports-v1', 'create-helper_trade_group_view-v1', 'redefine-deal_ticket_active_lots_view-v2-latest-active-lot', 'create-procedure-sp_refresh_sensitivity_report_cache-V4', 'create-deal-ticket-table-with-fy-premium-view-V4-active-lot-cache') ORDER BY orderexecuted

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE exectype = 'EXECUTED' AND id IN ('create-helper_var_accounting_report-view-v2', 'create-helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view-v2', 'create-helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view-v2-bu', 'add-tenant_id-to-curr_mult_table-v1', 'create-rmo-join-indexes-v1', 'create-deal_ticket_security_info_table_view-v1', 'create-helper-cash-balance-report-view-fast-v2-active-lot-cache', 'create-helper_eod_monthend_report_view-v2-bu', 'create-helper_risk_middle_office_reports-v1', 'create-helper_trade_group_view-v1')) AS required_executed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE exectype = 'EXECUTED' AND id = 'redefine-deal_ticket_active_lots_view-v2-latest-active-lot') AS thin_active_lots_view_executed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE id = 'create-procedure-sp_refresh_sensitivity_report_cache-V4' AND author = 'Nihal') AS nihal_sensitivity_changeset_ran, count(*) FILTER (WHERE id = 'create-deal-ticket-table-with-fy-premium-view-V4-active-lot-cache') AS nihal_fy_premium_v4_ran FROM opera.databasechangelog
SELECT locked::int AS locked FROM opera.databasechangeloglock

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = 'opera.helper_var_accounting_report'::regclass AND a.attname = 'tenant_id' AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS accounting_view_has_tenant_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = 'opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass AND a.attname IN ('business_unit', 'tenant_id') AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS settle_view_bu_tenant_columns, (SELECT (pg_get_viewdef('opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view'::regclass) NOT LIKE '%value_date AS settlement_date%')::int) AS settle_view_real_settlement_date, (SELECT (p.prosrc LIKE '%fn_sensitivity_report_source_v2%' AND p.prosrc LIKE '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%')::int FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname = 'sp_refresh_sensitivity_report_cache' LIMIT 1) AS sensitivity_procedure_is_staged_v4, (SELECT (pg_get_viewdef('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'::regclass) ILIKE '%og2%' AND pg_get_viewdef('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'::regclass) ILIKE '%ft.business_unit%')::int) AS fy_premium_fixing_join_scoped, (SELECT (pg_get_viewdef('opera.deal_ticket_active_lots_view'::regclass) LIKE '%latest_active_lot%')::int) AS active_lots_view_reads_cache, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('idx_security_info_tenant_bu_sec', 'idx_sec_settle_value_tenant_bu_sec_vd') AND i.indisvalid) AS rmo_indexes_valid, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name = 'curr_mult_table' AND column_name = 'tenant_id') AS curr_mult_has_tenant_id

SELECT 1 AS probe_ok, max(settlement_date) AS max_settle FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)
SELECT business_unit, count(*) AS view_rows, count(DISTINCT trade_id) AS trades FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view GROUP BY business_unit HAVING count(*) <> count(DISTINCT trade_id)

SELECT count(*) AS engine_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE upper(p1_name) LIKE 'CM OR%') AS cm_or_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_date = (SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) LIMIT 1)) AS rows_with_valuation_settlement_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p1_settleprice IS NOT NULL AND p1_settleprice <> 0) AS rows_with_underlying_price, max(created_timestamp) AS last_written FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd AND upper(created_by) = 'SYSTEM'

SELECT upper(business_unit) AS business_unit, value_date, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.var_accounting_table WHERE upper(created_by) = 'SYSTEM' AND created_timestamp > now() - interval '12 hours' AND upper(business_unit) <> upper(:bu) GROUP BY upper(business_unit), value_date
SELECT count(*) AS result_rows FROM opera.var_report_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = upper(:bu) AND value_date = :vd

expect.reason: the 10 changesets of PRs 290, 291 and 292 that stay in the changelog ran (EXECUTED)
PR 290: helper_var_accounting_report has tenant_id (Combined VAR filters by it)
PR 290: the statement of the Combined VAR service (max settlement date by tenant) runs
PRs 291 and 292: the settle pricing view carries business_unit and tenant_id (the engine filters by business_unit)
the settle pricing view returns the settlement date of the snapshot, not the value date

PR 293: sp_refresh_sensitivity_report_cache is the staged V4 (calls fn_sensitivity_report_source_v2, advisory lock), not Nihal's V3-style text. 0 means PR 292 was deployed without PR 293: run recon-functions/sp_refresh_sensitivity_report_cache_v4.sql
PR 293: the fy-premium view keeps the XOGA-65 scope of the fixing_table join (og2, ogp, rba, rbc, usg only)
no business unit repeats a trade in the fy-premium view (the unscoped fixing join of the V4 changeset would)

PR 293: deal_ticket_active_lots_view is the thin view over latest_active_lot. 0 means the changeset was skipped: fn_latest_active_lot_reconcile reported a difference or the cache is empty; reconcile, then restart core
PR 293: both RMO join indexes exist and are valid (a CONCURRENTLY build that was interrupted leaves an INVALID index)
curr_mult_table has tenant_id (0: the changeset was skipped, the database has several tenants and rows; backfill by hand)
Part B: the Run Report wrote rows (created_by SYSTEM) for the business unit and value date: run it first and use the same vd and bu
engine PR 53 with PR 52: CFS and ROV take the CM OR products (160 rows were missing before)
the engine rows carry the settlement date of the valuation date (core settle view v2 read by the engine)
p1_settleprice is the underlying price (it was the deal price, 0 for most rows, before)
the Run Report wrote only the requested business unit
the Run Report wrote VaR results (var_report_table)
